Name: Nebius Token Factory
Summary: OpenAI-compatible inference with PAYG, a small signup trial and optional Builder offers.

SetupSteps.Title: Review onboarding and billing
SetupSteps.Description: Normal signup requires a billing account and bank card. Review the terms before creating your own account; lain does not register or add payment data.

SetupSteps.Title: Obtain an API key
SetupSteps.Description: Create an API key in your own Token Factory account.

SetupSteps.Title: Select a concrete model
SetupSteps.Description: Copy the current model ID from the Models page. GET /models?verbose=true can report account/model pricing, context and rate limits. GLM/Kimi availability must be checked.

SetupSteps.Title: Optional Builder Program
SetupSteps.Description: Join and claim eligible offers separately if desired. Membership credit and application-based compute grants are distinct, optional and not counted as account balance.

BillingPlans.Name: Normal signup trial
BillingPlans.ResetDescription: One-time credit, valid 30 days; actual start/expiry unknown.
BillingPlans.Notes: Official offer is $1 trial credit valid for 30 days. A billing account and bank card are required. Actual grant/balance unknown.

BillingPlans.Name: Optional Builder membership offer
BillingPlans.ResetDescription: No recurring reset or verified expiry. Separate compute grants require application.
BillingPlans.Notes: Optional program currently advertises $25 Token Factory credit subject to eligibility, availability and terms. Joining/claiming is separate. Not guaranteed or added to balance; expiry unknown.

BillingPlans.Name: Token Factory PAYG
BillingPlans.Notes: Paid inference; automatic card charges can occur. Retrieve current model pricing rather than using example rates.

Routes.Name: DeepSeek R1 · documented example
Routes.FreeOnlyEnforcement: No independently verified billing cutoff; trial credit is not a free route.
Restrictions: Official quick-start example, not a live-verified availability claim.
Model-specific tools, streaming, reasoning controls, images, structured output and token limits remain unverified.

Sources.Title: Billing & Consumption
Sources.Notes: $1/30-day signup trial; billing and card required; auto charging.

Sources.Title: AI Builder Program
Sources.Notes: Optional membership credit, eligibility and application-based compute grants.

Restrictions: Trial and Builder currency credit are not tokens or permanent free tiers.
Builder Program is primarily for learning, testing and experimentation; verify offer terms and any expiry before use.
Actual credit balances, eligibility and expiry are unknown; optional compute grants require separate application.
Rate limits vary dynamically; observed rate-limit headers describe headroom, not remaining billing credit.
Trial use can lead to paid continuation and automatic card charges; free-only routing is blocked.
